newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers steady to soft in thin talks.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers steady to soft in thin talks.

text.p: Singapore bunkers were steady to slightly weaker in thin talks on soft swaps with shipowners hoping for further price falls, traders said on Thursday.

Prices slipped on Wednesday in line with cargo weakness, but some suppliers were optimistic, citing the fall in the Singapore's weekly residue stocks. Stocks fell by 1.634 million barrels to 10.595 million barrels in the week ending March 5.

While bullish suppliers were expecting prices to climb later Thursday, shipowners were hoping that prices would fall with swaps. Bunker 380-cst was at indicated $96-$102 per tonne, 180-cst at $102-$107. -- Singapore Newsroom (+65-870 3571)
